They're bringing out tankier menaces!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 14 (Formerly, [[Easy Mode|Easy]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Armored Toilet''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Armored]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every modern [[Armored]] variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a high amount of health and defense, though it has an above average speed, same speed as the [[Toilet]]. ==Appearance== The '''Toilet''' is a white toilet. It has a pale skinned head coming out of it, which uses the {{RLinkC|86487700|Man Face}} and wears a grey riot helmet. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Crook Boss]] can be very useful against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting the firerate and range of these towers respectively. *Defense dropping towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Freezer]] or [[Pyromancer]] can be useful at dropping its defense. **Some of these can be especially useful as they can also slow them down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1ArmoredToilet.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseArmoredToilet.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ArmoredToiletIconIG.png|'''Armored Toilet''' on its [[Index]] icon.
